ns2:course.label: Pathobiology II
ns2:course.description: Infectious disease concepts in parasitology, protozoology, bacteriology, mycology, and virology; and introduces basic antimicrobial pharmacology. 0 or 10 hours. Prerequisite: VM 605, VM 606, and good standing in the veterinary professional curriculum; or consent of instructor.
